blocs.titre: A kitchen to cook like at home
blocs.texte: Electric cooker, fridge, sink, worktops and utensils. Everyone tidies and cleans up after their meal.
Sofa, TV and dining area to watch a film, chat or study together.
The plot is enclosed by a solid wall with a gate. Two attendants are on site 24/7 to help you. The neighbourhood is calm and decent.

chambres_page.intro: The current house has two 4-bed rooms (bunk beds). Every resident has their own bed, pillow and sheets. A new 6-room house is being built on the same plot.

acces_page.intro: The Dorms is in the Quartier Industriel (Kampemba), a quiet area close to the universities, transport and shops.

venir: Take the British International School road in the Quartier Industriel.
Continue on Avenue Mungunzi prolongé to number 24.
Lost? Call us or send your location on WhatsApp and we will guide you.

reglement_page.intro: These rules let everyone study, sleep and live calmly. They apply to all residents and their visitors, and are signed on arrival.

regles.texte: Everyone respects other residents' person, sleep, studies, religion and belongings. Disagreements are settled by talking, then with the manager.
Silence, headphones required, calls in a low voice outside the rooms. During the day keep the volume reasonable, especially during exams.
Visits from 6 am to 9 pm, preferably in the lounge, 2 visitors at most per resident. In a bedroom only with the roommates' agreement.
Not allowed without prior permission from the manager and the roommates' agreement, 1 night per month at most, never in another resident's bed.
Bed made and things tidied every day. No food or dishes in the bedrooms. Lounge, kitchen, toilet and bathroom are cleaned on the rota and left clean after use.
In the closed bins provided. No rubbish in the yard or the street.
Turn off taps, lights and unused appliances. High-power appliances only with permission. No makeshift connections.
No cooking or stoves in the bedrooms, no unattended candles, do not touch the electrical installation. Close doors and windows.
Keys may not be lent or copied. The gate is locked from midnight to 5 am; no resident is left outside.
Keep valuables locked in your locker. Nobody touches another person's things without permission.
Subletting, giving or lending your place, even for a few days, is not allowed without written agreement.
Report any damage the same day. Residents must not repair electrics or plumbing themselves.
Violence, threats, harassment and hazing are forbidden, as are drugs. Alcohol, if consumed, must not cause noise or trouble.
Tell the manager about any absence longer than 7 days.

faq.q: Who can stay at The Dorms?
faq.r: Students, who rent a bed by the month, and travellers passing through Lubumbashi, who rent a bed by the night.
$80 per month for students ($240 per term), water and electricity included. $15 per night for travellers.

faq.q: What is included in the price?
faq.r: Your bed with mattress, sheets and pillow, the equipped kitchen, hot shower, lounge with TV, Wi-Fi, 24/7 borehole water and electricity.
Fill in the booking form with your dates or months. We check and reply on WhatsApp with payment instructions. Your place is confirmed once paid.
In cash on site, or by M-Pesa, Orange Money or Airtel Money, only after we confirm. We never take automatic online payments.
Yes, by appointment. Send a WhatsApp message to +243 855 847 085 or call +243 863 472 047.
Yes, each room in the current house has 4 beds (bunk beds). Double and single rooms are coming soon in the new house.
Yes. The plot is enclosed by a solid wall with a gate, and two attendants are on site 24/7.

faq.q: Are there water or power cuts?
faq.r: Water comes from our borehole with a self-filling tank, available 24/7. Electricity is constant.
Yes, residents share the equipped kitchen. Cooking in the bedrooms is not allowed.
Yes, from 6 am to 9 pm, preferably in the lounge, with 2 visitors at most per resident. Overnight guests need permission.
At 24 Avenue Mungunzi prolongé, Quartier Industriel, Lubumbashi, on the British International School road, near the universities.
